recommendation: Keep this source fix. It restores the published FHIR-I clarification without reviving obsolete example text or the old note-list structure, and it preserves the separate FHIR-25744 shared SearchParameter guidance as an adjacent specialized paragraph.
issue_request: FHIR-16103 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification request for the FHIR-core compatibility/versioning page. It asked to move the R4 ballot-intro mixed normative content discussion into the main specification near the FMM maturity-level documentation and to note that operations and profiles may have a lower maturity than the resources they reference, but cannot have a higher maturity.
initial_application: The request was initially applied by git commit 008e2ec15d026357bc974bb2663f86336cd31665, which moved the Mixed Normative content section from source/ballot-intro.html into source/versions.html under svn revision 14253. Later edits refined the example and notes in that section, including FHIR-47043 and FHIR-47046 changes.
additional_context: source/versions.html and source/formats.html are active build pages through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. Commit 7466cfc63cd0b162497a42c80a67480eed86c75a later removed the entire Mixed Normative content block from source/versions.html, including the FHIR-16103 operations/profiles maturity note and other notes. The already-published FHIR-25744 reconciliation restored only the shared SearchParameter clarification from that deleted block. FHIR-47043 and FHIR-47046 are already represented on the combined branch as no-change audits because their narrower example/readability requests were not themselves a reason to reintroduce the old block.
reconciliation: Added a current Mixed Normative content subsection in source/versions.html explaining mixed standards status within artifacts, inherited normative content in Trial Use artifacts, and the operation/profile FMM rule required by FHIR-16103. Updated source/formats.html so its Mixed Normative content reference links to versions.html#mixed.
source_changes: source/versions.html: restored the versions.html#mixed subsection with mixed standards-status/FMM guidance and the operations/profiles maturity constraint.
source/formats.html: retargeted the Mixed Normative content link in the TU flag legend from versions.html#std-process to versions.html#mixed.

related_jiras.note: The shared SearchParameter normativity clarification was removed by the same 7466cfc63c cleanup and has already been restored on the combined branch; this commit leaves that separate fix intact.
Later issue corrected the old mixed-normative example from Bundle.signature to Bundle.issues; this restoration avoids any resource-specific example, so no duplicate FHIR-47043 action is needed.
Later issue consolidated the old note paragraphs/list; this restoration uses concise prose and does not reintroduce the old separate Note/Notes structure.
